correctness.rationale: From the frozen RESULT.md and verification/verify.py: the two Gray coordinate maps T0(d1,d2)=(d2,d1), T1(d1,d2)=(d1+d2,d1) are invertible; their excluded dimension-(a+b) spaces meet in a dimension t=b+|A∩B| space. Every projective point outside the intersection occurs with multiplicity 2(q-1) outside the union or q-1 in the symmetric difference. Count with inclusion-exclusion; projective core is complement of a t-flat and has rank 2m because t<2m. For r-dimensional subcodes, maximal common zero count is [2m-r]_q-[max(0,t-r)]_q, attainable by choosing annihilator in general position, proving d_r. Pairs of proportional columns give exact A2^perp; for q=2 a light column has a 3-column relation using x,y,x+y outside T when dim ambient/T>=2, establishing locality exactly 2. Independently recomputed q=2,m=2,A={0},B={1} class counts 10 heavy/4 light and dual A2=10; q=3 same sets 33/6 and A2=408. Finite tests corroborate, arbitrary-q proof is linear algebra. No assertion about full original-code generalized hierarchy.
